prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: transparent photographic stone-letter sculptures for an Astir brand identity exploration.
Input images are references only: image 1 is approved study34, image2 is approved study36, image3 is the actual ONENESS family statue photograph DSCF2954. Use the real statue's stone material, broad irregular hand-chisel marks, restrained weathering, color and sculptor's touch. Do not copy the lettering style from references1 or2 and do not include any person or figure.
Primary request: photograph exactly FOUR separate freestanding solid stone sculptures shaped recognizably as capital S, T, I, R, from left to right. These four objects feel created by the same artist from the same warm off-white limestone block as the family statue. They are sculpted objects with real material depth and artist-determined contours, never a normal typeset font with a texture overlaid.
Text verbatim: "STIR" — only four letters S T I R. Absolutely no A.
Composition: isolated front view, orthographic-like and straight-on, a single horizontal row, shared cap height and common baseline, all four letters fully in frame, equal quiet gaps and generous clear padding. Compact elegant widths suitable to join an A on the left later. Every letter is individually separated with transparent gaps. Keep a clear vertical I distinguishable from the T. S has open top and bottom curves; R has a clear bowl and diagonal leg.
Lighting/material: natural soft directional light from upper-left, warm ivory limestone with soft grey-beige recesses, irregular shallow incisions and occasional broad faceted chisel planes, believable dense stone, unpolished, subtle natural variation rather than all-over noisy texture. Similar material thickness and unified light across the four letters.
Background: a genuinely transparent PNG with a real alpha channel. No floor, backdrop, horizon, ground, stage, drop shadow outside the letter objects, white/gray background, checkerboard picture or transparency pattern. The empty space and counters must be actual transparent pixels.
Avoid: base, plinth, foundation, plaque, frame, pedestal, watermark, extra text, human heads or bodies inside these four letters, anatomy, bones, tusks, animal horn, melted wax, weird fantasy artifacts, exaggerated damage, medieval/game styling, masonry blocks, repeating/tiled/paneled/stamped texture, smooth computer-extruded font, polished marble veins.
Direction52 / restrained sculptor: thin, elegant and balanced individual stone objects, with quietly tapered strokes, subtle flare where stone needs strength, uneven tool-cut edges and small asymmetries that show the artist's hand. Sleek at a glance, tactile at close range. Not thin spindly bones: the solid stone is visibly dense, with modest depth and grounded feet. No conventional font serifs or decorative flourishes. Each letter has a coherent sculptural silhouette.

inspection.text: STIR, four separate letters; no A/base/extra objects
inspection.background: Opaque checkerboard generated into RGB; extraction required before composition
inspection.material: Warm ivory chiseled stone, sculptural depth, no repeating paneled texture
